evidence.files: C02: hosted media file management; upload, store and deliver images and video through a CDN

line: Upload, store, transform, and deliver images and video.

free.text: 25 shared credits/month; 1 GB storage per credit

cells.regions: US, EU, and Asia Pacific datacenter APIs

files.math: 100 GB of storage, plus about 50 to 100 GB of image and video delivery, uses 150 to 200 credits. The Plus plan includes 225 credits. No transformations are assumed.
